title: PLAY THIS HEALING PRAYER BEFORE YOU EAT — WATCH WHAT HAPPENS

Somebody's deliverance has been pending and heaven has just authorized the release. You came here thinking this was a prayer video. No, this is a divine appointment. This is a portal and I dare you to stay with me. I want you to lift your hands wherever you are. In your kitchen, in your car, in that hospital room, in that lonely apartment. Lift your hands and say, "Lord, I receive whatever you have for me tonight." Glory to God. There is a man I see a man something has been wrong in your body for months and you have been afraid to tell anyone. The Lord says tonight is your night. Don't move. Stay with me. Now, I want to open the word of God because faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. Romans chapter 10 verse 17. You cannot build anything in the spirit without the word as your foundation. So, I'm going to lay a word before I lay hands on the atmosphere. Turn with me not physically, just in your spirit to the book of Exodus chapter 15 verse 26. Write it down. I am the Lord that healeth thee. Not I was, not I used to be, not under certain conditions I might be. He said, "I am present, continuous, active, uninterrupted, perpetually operational." The Hebrew word there is Jehovah Rapha and scholars will tell you that Rapha doesn't just mean healing in the sense of curing sickness. Rapha means to mend, to stitch back together, to restore to original condition, to repair what was broken, to cause to be whole again. So, when God says I am Jehovah Rapha, he's not just saying I am your doctor. He's saying I am the one who can take something that has been shattered and restore it to its original blueprint. I am the one who can look at what the enemy has dismantled in your life, your body, your family, your future, and bring it back to what I originally intended. Are you hearing me? He bear them. Past tense, completed action. There is a legal transaction that happened on the cross of Calvary that most Christians do not understand. Jesus didn't just die for your sins. Like Mephibosheth, broken, crippled, forgotten, was invited to David's table and ate there every day. Second Samuel 9:13, you eat at the king's table, not because of who you are, but because of whose you are. Eat and be healed. Eat and be strengthened. Eat and be restored. Eat and live. And when you are done, you will rise from that table different. You will rise from that table carrying something. You will rise from that table with a testimony that is forming even as you eat. You will rise and you will tell somebody what God did. You will tell somebody about the meal that became a miracle. You will tell somebody about the prayer that changed your health and somebody else's life will be transformed because of your testimony. Revelation 12:11, and they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. Your testimony is a weapon. Use it. Father, I seal everything that has been done in this prayer under the blood of Jesus. I cover it. I protect it. I enforce it. I declare that what you have healed shall remain healed. What you have delivered shall remain delivered. What you have restored shall remain restored. What you have opened shall remain open. John 10:10 says the thief cometh not but for to steal and to kill and to destroy, but I am come that they might have life and that they might have it more abundantly, more abundantly. That is your portion. Abundance of health, abundance of life, abundance of peace, abundance of provision, abundance of joy, abundance of years, abundance of purpose, more abundantly in Jesus name. Now, I want you to say these words after me with everything in you. Say them like you believe them. Say them like the angels are listening because they are. I am healed by the stripes of Jesus. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. No weapon formed against my health shall prosper. I eat and I am nourished. I eat and I am strengthened. My food is sanctified by the word of God and prayer. I shall live and not die. I shall declare the works of the Lord. My healing is settled in heaven. I receive it now in the name of Jesus. Amen. Glory to God. Something broke. Something shifted. I felt it in the spirit. Somebody's report is going to change. Somebody's test result is going to shock their doctors. Somebody who came to this prayer with a heavy body is going to eat that meal and feel something lift off them. This was not a coincidence. This was a divine assignment. Now go and eat and watch what happens. The Lord bless you. The Lord keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Numbers 6:24-26. In Jesus' mighty name. Amen.
